title: 第3章 抢夺灵粥第4章 炼气一重
content_zh:
第3章抢夺灵粥
“走，去干活，若是迟了，会被管事责罚。”
刚结束没多久，小胖子的声音，便在林浩耳朵中响起。
“好。”
林浩点头，与小胖子一起出了屋子。
跟大量同样穿着杂役弟子服饰的人，往灵矿山方向赶去。
大概半盏茶时间后，来到了目的地。
领了挖矿的工具，林浩他们在一名内门弟子矿石区管事的监督下，进入了矿洞中。
矿洞并不昏暗，每隔一段路程，便有特殊照明的灯。
林浩走在矿洞中，四下打量。
发现，洞壁都是红褐色的石头。
在矿洞中，不用担心塌陷之类的事情发生。
因为，林浩昨晚听小胖子王富说，在矿洞中布置了阵法，可保证进入矿洞的杂役弟子安全。
并且每隔一段时间宗门的高手，都会进入矿洞中维护阵法。
拿着挖矿的十字镐，林浩和小胖子来到一个巨大的地下空洞。
地面有大量碎石头，和被杂役弟子挖出来的坑坑洼洼。
“咚咚！
锵！
锵！”
一群来到矿洞的杂役弟子们，开始干活。

林浩虽然穿越到这个世界没多久，但小时候也干过农活。
他并不怕苦，拿起十字镐，像模像样的挖了起来。
这灵矿中的石头，硬度远超寻常石头，挖起来太难，必须用尽全力才行！
才挖了不到半个时辰，林浩就感觉双手酸痛。
而灵铁他目前却只挖出不到半斤，距离挖出五斤灵铁可吃一顿饭的目标，还差太远。
忍着疲惫拼命挖矿中，时间一点一点的过去。
差不多在太阳下山好一会儿，快要天黑的时候。
林浩累死累活才挖出四斤灵铁，还差一斤灵铁才能换取一碗灵粥，若不是小胖子王富，帮他挖了一些。
他估计今天，一顿饭都吃不上。
“走！
去吃饭。”
王富和林浩，两人拿着今天挖出的矿，去管理矿区的内门弟子那里，各自领取了一张吃饭凭证。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Snatching the Spiritual Porridge
"Let's go and do the work. If you are late, you will be punished by the steward."
Not long after it ended, the little fat man's voice sounded in Lin Hao's ears.
"Okay."
Lin Hao nodded and left the house with the little fat man.
Along with a large number of people who were also wearing the uniforms of handyman disciples, they rushed towards the direction of Ling Mine.
After about half a cup of tea, we arrived at our destination.
After receiving the mining tools, Lin Hao and the others entered the mine under the supervision of an inner disciple ore area manager.
The mine is not dark, and there are special lighting lights every once in a while.
Lin Hao walked in the mine and looked around.
It was found that the walls of the cave were all made of reddish-brown stone.
In the mine, there is no need to worry about collapse or anything like that.
Because Lin Hao heard from the fat man Wang Fu last night that he had arranged a formation in the mine to ensure the safety of the handyman disciples who entered the mine.
And every once in a while, the masters of the sect will enter the mine to maintain the formation.
Holding the mining pickaxe, Lin Hao and the little fat man came to a huge underground cavity.
There are a lot of broken stones on the ground, as well as pits dug out by the handyman disciples.
“Dong dong!
Clang!
Clang! "
A group of handyman disciples came to the mine and started working.
Although Lin Hao traveled to this world not long ago, he also did farm work when he was a child.
He was not afraid of hardship, picked up the pickaxe, and started digging decently.
The stone in this spiritual mine is much harder than ordinary stone. It is too difficult to dig out and you must use all your strength!
After digging for less than half an hour, Lin Hao felt his hands were sore.
However, he has only dug out less than half a kilogram of spiritual iron so far. He is still far from the goal of digging out five kilograms of spiritual iron for one meal.
While enduring the exhaustion and digging hard, time passed little by little.
It was almost after the sun went down for a while and it was almost dark.
Lin Hao worked very hard to dig out four kilograms of spiritual iron. He still had one kilogram less to exchange for a bowl of spiritual porridge. If it weren't for the fat man Wang Fu, he helped him dig some.
He estimated that he wouldn't be able to eat a single meal today.
"Go!
Go and have a meal. "
Wang Fu and Lin Hao took the mine dug out today and went to the inner disciples who managed the mining area, and each received a meal voucher.
